mapper.insert: INSERT INTO novel_project (project_code, title, genre, target_chapter_count, words_per_chapter, current_chapter_number, status) VALUES (#{projectCode}, #{title}, #{genre}, #{targetChapterCount}, #{wordsPerChapter}, #{currentChapterNumber}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE novel_project SET title = #{title}, genre = #{genre}, target_chapter_count = #{targetChapterCount}, words_per_chapter = #{wordsPerChapter}, current_chapter_number = #{currentChapterNumber}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE novel_project SET current_chapter_number = GREATEST(current_chapter_number, #{chapterNumber}), status = 'WRITING' WHERE id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_code, title, genre, target_chapter_count, words_per_chapter, current_chapter_number, status, created_at, updated_at FROM novel_project WHERE project_code = #{projectCode}
SELECT id, project_code, title, genre, target_chapter_count, words_per_chapter, current_chapter_number, status, created_at, updated_at FROM novel_project ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
